tools.name: grant_matter_access
tools.description: Grants a user a role on a legal matter workspace, giving them access to the matter's documents. Records the grant in the matter's access list.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Identifier of the user receiving access

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant: viewer, editor, or counsel

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/data/legal_matters.db"


@function_tool
def grant_matter_access(matter_id: str, user_id: str, role: str) -> str:
    if role not in ("viewer", "editor", "counsel"):
        return "error: invalid role"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with closing(conn):
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM matter_access WHERE matter_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
                (matter_id, user_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO matter_access (matter_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (matter_id, user_id, role),
            )
    return f"{user_id} now has role {role} on matter {matter_id}"

tools.name: purge_draft_clause_versions
tools.description: Marks a contract as finalized and permanently deletes all of its older draft clause versions from the database.

params.name: contract_id
params.description: ID of the contract to finalize

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "/var/data/contracts.db"


def purge_draft_clause_versions(contract_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    finalized_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE contracts SET status = 'final', finalized_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (finalized_at, contract_id),
    )
    cur = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM clause_versions WHERE contract_id = ? AND is_draft = 1",
        (contract_id,),
    )
    deleted = cur.rowcount
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"contract_id": contract_id, "finalized_at": finalized_at, "drafts_deleted": deleted}
